highlight: Data Scientist with 4 years of experience shipping production ML on Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and AWS — recommendation systems, MLOps, RAG/LLM apps, and decision dashboards used by business teams.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Building enterprise-scale ML systems across recommendation, MLOps automation, and analytics on Microsoft Fabric and Databricks.
Central Recommendation Engine (CRE): engineered predictive algorithms on multi-signal behavioral data for real-time personalization across global supply-chain markets.
MLOps UI Platform: architected an ML backend that abstracts training, versioning, and deployment into a low-code interface for non-ML teams.
Hybrid ML disaggregation pipeline: decomposed national KPIs into regional and SKU-level projections for supply planning.
TCMS: embedded lookalike models and autonomous KPI computation into production Power BI dashboards on Microsoft Fabric.

experience.title: Data Scientist & AI Engineer
bullets: Delivered end-to-end AI solutions across search, NLP, LLM fine-tuning, and analytics on AWS.
Semantic video search: transcript-aware retrieval on AWS Transcribe, OpenSearch, SageMaker, and Bedrock.
Waves OTT recommendation engine: hybrid collaborative filtering + metadata embeddings with cold-start fallback.
Mentor Policy Chatbot: fine-tuned LLaMA 3.1-8B-Instruct (LoRA/PEFT) and deployed a LangChain RAG pipeline.
Enterprise document intelligence: transformer NLP for moderation, classification, and summarization with Bhashini and Cloud Vision OCR.
Churn and sentiment analytics: ensemble churn model at 85% accuracy plus real-time speech sentiment pipelines.

experience.title: Data Analyst

Built fault-tolerant scraping and ingestion (Selenium, BeautifulSoup, SQLAlchemy, Great Expectations), cutting manual intervention by 90%.
Designed ETL with schema validation and quality gates for audit-ready legal/regulatory KPIs.
Delivered Power BI dashboards for legal operations, regulatory risk, and business performance.

experience.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Built NLP automation for legal document processing through production API integration.
BERT document classification on legal/insurance docs (PyMuPDF + regex) at 92% accuracy.
Domain-adapted SpaCy NER for parties, clauses, and dates, reducing manual review by 60%.
Packaged models as Flask REST APIs in the client's intake management system.

Inventory and supplier dashboards in Power BI and Streamlit.
